questions.question: What is the 'Better Together' principle in ServiceNow CSM implementation?

options.text: A team collaboration framework for agents
Integrating CSM with other ServiceNow applications like ITSM for end-to-end processes
A customer loyalty program
A training methodology for new agents

explanation.correct: The 'Better Together' principle emphasizes integrating CSM with other ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, etc.) to create end-to-end processes. For example, CSM cases can automatically create incidents for IT-related issues.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Better Together refers to application integration, not team frameworks
It's an architectural principle, not a customer program
Better Together is about platform integration, not training

questions.question: What is Article Quality Index (AQI) in ServiceNow Knowledge Management?

options.text: A measure of how long articles take to write
A score that measures knowledge article quality based on feedback and usage metrics
An index of all available articles
A ranking of article authors

explanation.correct: Article Quality Index (AQI) is a score that measures knowledge article quality based on factors like user feedback, view counts, attachment of articles to cases, and other usage metrics.

wrongAnswers.explanation: AQI measures quality outcomes, not authoring time
AQI is a quality score, not a catalog index
AQI evaluates articles, not authors

questions.question: What are knowledge blocks used for in CSM?

options.text: To block access to sensitive knowledge articles
To create reusable content that can be shared across multiple knowledge articles
To organize articles into categories
To schedule knowledge article publications

explanation.correct: Knowledge blocks allow creating reusable content that can be shared across multiple knowledge articles. When the block is updated, all articles using that block automatically reflect the change.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Access control is handled through knowledge bases and ACLs, not blocks
Article categorization uses knowledge bases and categories
Publication scheduling is separate from knowledge blocks

questions.question: Why is defining project scope important in CSM implementations?

options.text: It limits the number of users who can access the system
It ensures the implementation focuses on business-critical features and avoids scope creep
It reduces the license costs
It automatically configures all CSM features

explanation.correct: Properly defining project scope ensures the CSM implementation focuses on business-critical features, delivers value quickly, and avoids scope creep that can delay go-live and increase costs.

wrongAnswers.explanation: User access is separate from project scope definition
Scope definition is about functionality, not licensing
Configuration requires explicit setup regardless of scope

questions.question: What does bulk translation capability provide in Knowledge Management?

options.text: Automatic real-time translation of chat messages
The ability to translate multiple knowledge articles to different languages efficiently
Translation of ServiceNow interface elements
Voice-to-text translation for phone calls

explanation.correct: Bulk translations in Knowledge Management allow organizations to efficiently translate multiple knowledge articles to different languages, supporting global customer service operations.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Chat translation is separate from bulk knowledge translation
Interface translation is handled by platform localization
Voice translation is not part of bulk translations

questions.question: An organization using CSM receives many IT-related customer cases. Following the 'Better Together' principle, what integration should they implement?

options.text: Integration with external ticketing systems only
Integration with ServiceNow ITSM to create incidents from CSM cases
No integration is needed; CSM handles all IT issues
Integration with the marketing automation platform

explanation.correct: Following the Better Together principle, CSM should integrate with ITSM so that IT-related customer issues can automatically create incidents for the IT team to resolve, maintaining end-to-end visibility.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Better Together emphasizes ServiceNow-to-ServiceNow integration
IT issues often require ITSM processes and tools
Marketing integration doesn't address IT issue resolution

questions.question: What is the recommended approach for handling entitlements that use 'hours' as the unit type?

options.text: The platform automatically tracks hours through the Remaining Units field
Customers must create a custom business rule to deduct hours based on agent time spent
Hours-based entitlements are not supported in CSM
A scheduled job calculates hours from timecard entries

explanation.correct: While case-based entitlements have a built-in business rule ('Update case entitlement on Close'), hours-based entitlements require customers to create a separate business rule. For example, a rule that deducts the time an agent spends on a case when it is resolved.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Automatic tracking only works for case-based units. Hours require a custom business rule.
Hours are a supported unit type — they just require custom business rule implementation.
There is no out-of-box scheduled job for this. A custom business rule is needed.

questions.question: When implementing escalation management in CSM, what should be created to control the escalation process?

options.text: Escalation rules and notification templates
Escalation templates and severity definitions
Escalation workflows and approval policies
Escalation groups and routing rules

explanation.correct: CSM escalation management requires creating escalation templates and severity definitions to control the escalation process. These define how escalations are handled and what severity levels are available.

wrongAnswers.explanation: While notifications may be involved, the core configuration is escalation templates and severity definitions.
Escalation templates and severity definitions are the primary configuration items, not workflows and approval policies.
Escalation management uses templates and severity definitions, not groups and routing rules.

questions.question: Which actions can a post case review approval workflow support? (Choose two.)

options.text: Approvers can suggest changes to the review document
Approvers receive email notifications about pending reviews
Reviews are automatically published after 48 hours without response
Rejected reviews are automatically deleted from the system

explanation.correct: The post case review approval workflow allows agents to add approval groups or users. Approvers can suggest changes or approve the document, and they receive email notifications about pending reviews.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Reviews require explicit approval — they don't auto-publish on timeout.
Rejected reviews may need revision but are not automatically deleted.

questions.question: An organization wants to share addresses across related accounts in their account hierarchy. What CSM feature supports this?

options.text: Account address domain separation
Address sharing through account hierarchy
Global address book
Contact address inheritance

explanation.correct: CSM supports address sharing through account hierarchy, allowing related accounts to share addresses. This is separate from address sharing for non-related accounts.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Domain separation controls data visibility across domains, not address sharing between accounts.
There is no 'global address book' feature in CSM — address sharing is hierarchy-based.
Contact address inheritance is not a CSM feature. Address sharing works at the account level through hierarchy.

questions.question: Which plugin must be activated before using the Major Issue Management feature in CSM?

options.text: com.sn_customerservice only
com.sn_majorissue_mgt
com.sn_incident_management
com.sn_case_escalation

explanation.correct: The Major Issue Management plugin (com.sn_majorissue_mgt) must be activated. It requires Customer Service, Targeted Communications, and Task Communications Management plugins.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Customer Service is a prerequisite but not the Major Issue Management plugin itself.
Incident Management is a separate ITSM application, not the CSM Major Issue Management plugin.
com.sn_case_escalation is not a real ServiceNow plugin name for this feature.

source.excerpt: Search for the plugin com.sn_majorissue_mgt. Click Activate.

questions.question: Which plugins are automatically activated when the Case Digests plugin is installed? (Choose two.)

options.text: Targeted Communications (com.sn_publications)
Advanced Work Assignment (com.snc.awa)
ServiceNow Document Viewer (com.snc.documentviewer)
Virtual Agent (com.glide.cs.chatbot)

explanation.correct: The Case Digests plugin automatically activates Customer Service, Customer Service Document Template, ServiceNow Document Viewer, and Targeted Communications plugins.

wrongAnswers.explanation: AWA is not automatically activated by the Case Digests plugin.
Virtual Agent is a separate plugin not required by Case Digests.

source.excerpt: The Case Digests plugin automatically activates Customer Service, Customer Service Document Template, ServiceNow Document Viewer, and Targeted Communications.

questions.question: What does the Case Action Status feature track in CSM?

options.text: Customer satisfaction scores for resolved cases
Blocking tasks created for customer service cases and updates action status indicators
Time spent by agents on each case action
The number of case reassignments within a service team

explanation.correct: Case Action Status provides a CSM-specific application of the Action Status Automation feature, tracking blocking tasks created for customer service cases and updating action status indicators.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Customer satisfaction tracking is handled by survey features, not Case Action Status.
Time tracking is an SLA or timecard feature, not Case Action Status.
Case reassignment tracking is not the purpose of Case Action Status.

source.excerpt: Case action status tracks blocking tasks created for customer service cases and updates the action status indicators.

questions.question: In CSM, which feature does Major Issue Management use to identify impacted customers?

options.text: Customer Service Agent Groups
Targeted Communications recipient lists
CMDB relationship maps
Account hierarchy filters

explanation.correct: Major Issue Management uses the Targeted Communications recipients lists feature to identify impacted customers.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Agent Groups are for case assignment, not identifying impacted customers.
CMDB relationship maps show CI dependencies, not customer impact for major issues.
Account hierarchy filters are not the mechanism used by Major Issue Management.

source.excerpt: Major issue management uses the Targeted Communications recipients lists feature to identify impacted customers.
